dogecoin.text: @FBI @TheJusticeDept @dogecoin @DOGE The federal government regulates trade but they have never been allowed to make money. Check your sources.

@FBI @TheJusticeDept @dogecoin @DOGE I remember a report many years ago about how the @fbi or someone similar created shell companies in order to expose and catch organized crime. Those shell companies ended up making a lot of money and the federal government didn't know what to do because they're not for profit...

@FBI @TheJusticeDept @dogecoin @DOGE Is @dogecoin value be determined by how well or bad @DOGE is doing? The federal governments priority has never been making money. So why all of a sudden are departments being closed and people being fired because there is no money in their work? That's not how things are run.

Please @FBI @TheJusticeDept launch an investigation into @dogecoin and @DOGE.

Doge coin was released way before @DOGE was created. My question is... are they connected in some way? The federal government isn't in the business of making money. Did they have an agenda?
